differences.writeup_quote:
Each vector is a contrast of *stance*, built entirely from prompts I wrote, with no benchmark item

rationale: The write-up never names or points to Raman 2026/white-bear steering or any other prior work; it presents the stance-contrast construction as simply the author's own design with no discussion of precedent or novelty relative to a source. The closing message explicitly names raman2026-white-bear-steering.md, credits it with showing a stance contrast can make concepts readable in J-space, and frames the submitted method's novelty as deriving the direction from scratch rather than reproducing that paper—information and framing entirely absent from the write-up—while also mischaracterizing the write-up as describing the method's 'origin'.
